summary: I checked today's final Brazil election polls and the injury and weather news for Sunday's NFL games. The last pre-election polls, CNT/MDA and Atlas-Bloomberg from October 3, both still show Lula ahead of Flavio Bolsonaro by about 3 to 6 points in the first round, confirming the position I already hold, so I am keeping it as is. For the NFL, the injury stories I found on Lamar Jackson, Bucky Irving and Brock Bowers all resolved with those players clearing to play, and the Giants starting backup quarterback Jameis Winston is old news already reflected in the Cardinals line, so none of those cleared my edge bar. I made no trades this cycle.
